full_prompt_en: A square atmospheric landscape painting shows a line of tall golden trees and one tiny person beneath an immense dark cloud bank. The trees stretch from the left edge across much of the middle, their thin nearly parallel trunks descending toward a narrow strip of dark ground. Their foliage glows yellow-orange where a warm opening in the sky touches the upper branches. The canopies become thinner and more scattered toward the right, allowing blue-gray mist to show between the trunks. Near the center of the low dark shoreline, a single small human silhouette stands or walks to the right, reduced almost to a black mark against the pale haze. A smooth, nearly black reflective band fills the bottom edge, mirroring the warm foliage and the dark land in broken vertical streaks. Above the trees, a broad mass of slate, teal, and charcoal cloud fills the upper half, with ragged warm ocher openings at left and a hazier gold patch farther right. The horizon is low and almost level, so the cloud and vertical tree rhythm dominate the frame. No individual leaves are sharply described; the foliage is built from many soft clustered strokes, while the trunks remain thin and precise. Light seems to break through from the upper left, warming the upper canopy and leaving the water and ground in deep shadow. The overall composition sets a solitary tiny figure against an expansive glowing woodland edge, balancing luminous gold with storm-dark blue-green for a quiet, ominous mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、富有空气感的风景绘画呈现一排高高的金色树木和一个渺小人物，位于巨大的深色云层下。树木从左缘延伸过中部大部分区域，细而几乎平行的树干向下落到狭窄深色地面。天空中的暖色开口触及上部枝梢，使树冠发出黄橙色光泽。树冠越向右越稀疏分散，蓝灰薄雾从树干之间露出。低矮深色岸线中央附近，一个很小的人影站立或朝右行走，在浅雾前几乎缩成一笔黑色。底缘是一条平滑、近黑色的反光区域，以破碎竖影映出暖色树冠和暗色土地。树木上方，石板灰、青蓝和炭黑云团填满上半部，左侧有参差暖赭色开口，右方更远处有一块朦胧金色区域。地平线较低、近乎水平，因而云层和竖向树木节奏主导画面。单片树叶没有清晰描出；树冠由许多柔和簇状笔触组成，树干则细直明确。光似乎从左上突破云层，染暖上方树冠，让水面和地面沉入深影。整体构图把孤独小人放在宽阔发亮的林缘前，以明亮金黄平衡暴雨前般的深蓝绿，形成安静又不祥的气氛。
style_prompt_en: Atmospheric landscape painting contrasts luminous warm color with large storm-dark cool masses. Thin, nearly parallel vertical strokes support clustered orange-gold marks, while blue-gray mist lowers contrast near the horizon. Broad cloud forms are softly feathered and internally mottled rather than outlined, occupying generous upper space. A very low dark horizontal band anchors the composition and repeats color as broken vertical reflections. Light breaks unevenly through the upper field, making selected warm passages glow while neighboring surfaces remain shadowed. Tiny dark accents establish scale without interrupting the expansive color relationship. The overall effect is poetic, weather-laden, and quietly dramatic.
style_prompt_zh: 富有空气感的风景绘画把发亮的暖色与大面积暴雨般的冷暗色团对照。细而几乎平行的竖向笔触托住成簇的橙金笔点，蓝灰薄雾在地平线附近降低反差。宽阔云形边缘柔化、内部斑驳，没有被硬线勾出，占据充裕上方空间。一条极低的深色横带稳住构图，并以破碎竖影重复颜色。光不均匀地穿过上方色域，使选定暖色区域发亮，邻近表面仍处于阴影。极小的深色重音建立尺度，却不打断宽阔的色彩关系。整体效果富于诗意、承载天气感，并安静地具有戏剧性。
theme_en: Golden trees and a tiny solitary figure beneath a dark cloud bank
theme_zh: 金色树林与渺小的独行者位于深色云层下
name: Peter Holme III
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
